SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hey, Yuman! Take this with you on the way!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 吴宥万！这个带着路上吃！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 吳宥萬！這個帶著路上吃！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: おいユマン！これ食べながら行きな！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hei, Yuman! Bawa ini sekalian, ya!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ei, Yumán! Vai comendo isso no caminho.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Oye, Yumán! Ve comiendo esto en el camino
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هی، یومان! اینو در راه با خود ببرید!

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ありがとうございます

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Don’t forget about your appointment today, okay?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 今日の診察、忘れないで！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Jangan lupa janji temu kamu hari ini, oke?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não esquece que hoje você tem consulta médica!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡No olvides que hoy  tienes cita médica!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: قرار ملاقات امروز خود را فراموش نکنید، خوب؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yu-jeong! Can you grab my socks?!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 有情啊！把姐姐的袜子拿过来！！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 有情啊！把姐姐的襪子拿過來！！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユジョン！お姉ちゃんの靴下ちょっと！！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Yu-jeong! Bisa ambilin kaus kaki aku nggak?!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Yujeong, traz uma meia pra mim, por favor!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Here, let me get them for you!
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nih, biar aku aja yang ambilin!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: در اینجا، اجازه دهید من اونا رو برای شما!
